Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend, an English teacher, who plans to organize a one-day outdoor field trip for her students and is asking for your advice. Write an email responding to her:

- Recommend whether students should share their experience after the trip by writing a letter/essay or recording a video
title: Task 1.1: Advising a Friend on Organizing a 1-Day Field Trip for English Students
content:
You have received an email from your friend, an English teacher, who plans to organize a one-day outdoor field trip for her students and is asking for your advice. Write an email responding to her:

- Advise whether she should choose the city museum or the central park

- Recommend whether students should share their experience after the trip by writing a letter/essay or recording a video

body.answer: I believe you should choose the central park for a one-day outdoor field trip instead of the city museum.
body.example: You can organize an English speaking treasure hunt on the grass, which is much livelier than walking quietly inside a museum.
body.reason: Being outdoors in fresh air is beneficial to the students' physical and mental health, and the open space helps them build a strong sense of belonging through team games.

body.reason: Bringing packed food is fast, convenient, and fits comfortably within the students' budget without wasting time waiting for restaurant service.
body.requirement: Suggest suitable food to bring along or whether to eat at a restaurant

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that asking students to record a short video is better than writing a letter or essay.
body.example: Each student can record a two-minute clip talking about their favorite game in the park and share it in your class group chat.
body.reason: Making a video helps students make the most of new technology, practice speaking naturally, and allow their brain to exercise creatively.
body.requirement: Recommend whether students should share their experience by writing a letter/essay or recording a video

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Children Learning Musical Instruments
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many parents enroll their children in extracurricular music classes to learn how to play musical instruments. While music lessons can nurture talent and discipline, they may also add pressure and take away children's free time."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of letting children learn to play musical instruments. Support your arguments with specific reasons and examples.
title: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Children Learning Musical Instruments
content:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many parents enroll their children in extracurricular music classes to learn how to play musical instruments. While music lessons can nurture talent and discipline, they may also add pressure and take away children's free time."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of letting children learn to play musical instruments. Support your arguments with specific reasons and examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was quite restless and struggled to concentrate on his math homework in primary school. Therefore, he decided to join an afternoon guitar class and practiced for 30 minutes every day. As a result, he finally improved his memory, became more patient, and enjoyed relaxing with music after school. If he had not learned to play the guitar, he would not have been so focused in class.
body1.focus: Advantages: Brain exercise, better focus, and healthy relaxation
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, children learning to play musical instruments brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make learning musical instruments appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that learning a musical instrument allows children's brains to exercise creatively and improves their focus and memory. This means that reading notes and practicing steadily builds strong discipline that also helps with school subjects. Another point I would like to make is that playing music helps kids relieve stress and reduce fatigue in a healthy way. This is because of the fact that music elevates their mood and gives them a fun hobby away from phone screens.

body2.example: For example, I was forced to attend extra piano classes three evenings a week when I was twelve. For this reason, I got to feel exhausted and missed playing football with my neighborhood friends. If I had not talked honestly with my parents about my tight schedule, I would not have been able to know that too many lessons can turn a fun hobby into heavy pressure.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: High costs and extra pressure on children's free time
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of children learning to play musical instruments are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that high costs and extra pressure can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, buying instruments and paying for private classes cost a great deal of money, time, and effort for many families. This happens because when parents push young children to follow strict practice schedules, it easily leads to mental stress, tiredness, and family conflicts. In addition, spending too many hours in extra classes leaves kids with fewer opportunities to play outdoors and relax with friends.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, children learning to play musical instruments brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from stronger focus, creativity, and stress relief, they also need to handle high lesson costs and extra pressure on free time. Therefore, both individuals and schools should work together to make the most of music education responsibly.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Working from Home
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Thanks to advancements in digital technology, working from home has become increasingly widespread among modern employees and companies. While remote work offers flexibility and saves commuting time, it also presents challenges such as isolation and blurred work-life boundaries."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of working from home. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
title: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Working from Home
content:
Read the following statement:

"Thanks to advancements in digital technology, working from home has become increasingly widespread among modern employees and companies. While remote work offers flexibility and saves commuting time, it also presents challenges such as isolation and blurred work-life boundaries."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of working from home. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was exhausted from spending two hours in heavy traffic every day on his way to the office. Therefore, he decided to ask his manager for a remote working schedule from home. As a result, he finally saved time and fuel costs and had dinner with our parents every evening. If he had not switched to working from home, he would not have been so energetic and relaxed.
body1.focus: Advantages: Flexible time, quiet space, and less commuting
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, working from home brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make working from home appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that working from home is fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society. This means that employees save commuting time and travel money by joining meetings from home via laptop without heavy traffic. Another point I would like to make is that remote work helps staff reach a healthy balance between work and family time. This is because of the fact that a quiet, cozy environment at home lets workers focus comfortably and spend extra hours with loved ones.

body2.example: For example, I was working on a group IT project from my bedroom for three weeks straight last year. For this reason, I got to feel lonely and kept checking work messages late at night because my desk was next to my bed. If I had not experienced that stressful month, I would not have been able to know that working alone without clear hours can cause burnout quickly.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: Loneliness and blurred work-life boundaries
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of working from home are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that loneliness and unclear work-life limits can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, working remotely reduces face-to-face interaction with colleagues and weakens team spirit. This happens because when employees stay alone at home all week, it easily leads to feeling isolated and losing a strong sense of belonging at work. In addition, blurred boundaries between office time and rest time often make people work overtime and check work emails late at night.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, working from home brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from saving commuting time and flexible schedules, they also need to handle loneliness and blurred work-life boundaries. Therefore, both individuals and companies should work together to make the most of working from home responsibly.

intro.ld2: feeling lonely and losing clear work-life boundaries

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.3: Positive and Negative Impacts of Tourism Development
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In recent decades, the rapid development of tourism has brought significant economic opportunities to many regions, yet it has also raised concerns about environmental damage and local cultural preservation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive and negative impacts of tourism development. Give reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
title: Task 2.3: Positive and Negative Impacts of Tourism Development
content:
Read the following statement:

"In recent decades, the rapid development of tourism has brought significant economic opportunities to many regions, yet it has also raised concerns about environmental damage and local cultural preservation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive and negative impacts of tourism development. Give reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

body1.example: For instance, in many coastal cities and popular tourist areas today, local families open homestays, restaurants, and guided tours for visitors from around the world. As a result, residents earn higher incomes and local authorities have more money to upgrade roads and public services.
body1.focus: Positive impacts: Economic growth and cultural exchange
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, rapid tourism development brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make tourism development appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that tourism development helps boost economic development and improve people's living standard. This means that hotels, food stalls, and transport services create thousands of local jobs for residents. Another point I would like to make is that tourism promotes cultural exchange and helps visitors broaden their mind. This is because of the fact that travelers gain a deeper understanding of local people, culture, and tradition while supporting domestic workers directly.

body2.example: For example, many residents often face heavy plastic trash on beaches, noisy traffic jams, and rising living costs during peak holiday seasons. If this issue is ignored, it will cause lasting environmental damage and make quiet towns lose their traditional lifestyle.
body2.focus: Negative impacts: Environmental pollution and loss of local culture
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of rapid tourism development are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that environmental pollution and cultural loss can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, uncontrolled tourism puts heavy strain on nature and damages the local environment. This happens because when too many visitors crowd into one destination, it easily leads to piles of plastic waste, water pollution, and harmful exhaust fumes from tour buses. In addition, some local businesses change traditional customs just to attract quick money, which weakens local heritage over time.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, rapid tourism development brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from economic growth and better living standards, they also need to handle environmental pollution and damage to local culture. Therefore, both individuals and local authorities should work together to make the most of tourism development responsibly.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.4: Problems and Solutions of Internet Use in Modern Life
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Using the internet brings tremendous convenience and learning opportunities to modern society, yet it also causes serious concerns such as online addiction, cybercrime, and misinformation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the key problems associated with internet use and proposing practical solutions to address them.
title: Task 2.4: Problems and Solutions of Internet Use in Modern Life
content:
Read the following statement:

"Using the internet brings tremendous convenience and learning opportunities to modern society, yet it also causes serious concerns such as online addiction, cybercrime, and misinformation."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the key problems associated with internet use and proposing practical solutions to address them.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was staying up late every night scrolling through short videos and trusting random links on social media. Therefore, he decided to click a fake promotion link and lost money from his online bank account. As a result, he finally felt deeply stressed and fell asleep during morning classes. If he had not spent so many careless hours online, he would not have been tricked and exhausted.
body1.focus: Key problems: Internet addiction, cybercrime, and false information
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, excessive internet use leads to several serious negative effects | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key impacts of excessive internet use.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that spending too much time online causes internet addiction and harms people's health and focus. This means that students and workers lose concentration, sleep late, and spend less face-to-face time with family. Another point I would like to make is that careless internet use exposes people to cybercrime and false information. This is because of the fact that sharing private details online or clicking strange links allows cyber criminals to steal bank accounts and spread misleading news easily.

body2.example: For example, everyday users can limit daily screen time and verify news on trusted websites, while universities and tech companies hold online safety talks and block scam links quickly.
body2.focus: Practical solutions: Personal self-control, safer platforms, and digital education
body2.frame: Mở: In order to resolve such problems, both individuals and organizations should take practical measures | Ruột Solutions (Cá nhân + Tổ chức + Education)
body2.point: One primary solution would be that individuals should limit daily screen time, check trusted news sources, and stay on the safe side by protecting their personal information. In addition, tech companies and local authorities need to improve online security, remove false content quickly, and apply fair rules against cybercrime. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, excessive internet use in modern life is closely linked to online addiction, cybercrime, and false information and requires practical steps such as personal self-control, safer platforms, and digital education. Therefore, both citizens and local authorities need to take steady, practical actions to reduce this problem in the long run.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.5: Benefits of Sharing Household Chores in Modern Families
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Traditionally, fathers were expected to be the sole breadwinners while mothers took full responsibility for household chores. Today, many people argue that sharing housework equally among all family members brings significant benefits."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages of sharing household chores among family members. Give reasons and relevant examples.
title: Task 2.5: Benefits of Sharing Household Chores in Modern Families
content:
Read the following statement:

"Traditionally, fathers were expected to be the sole breadwinners while mothers took full responsibility for household chores. Today, many people argue that sharing housework equally among all family members brings significant benefits."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages of sharing household chores among family members. Give reasons and relevant examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was used to letting our mother cook and wash dishes alone after her long workday. Therefore, he decided to help prepare dinner and clean the kitchen every evening with our father. As a result, he finally saw our mother look much happier and less tired after work. If he had not started sharing daily chores, our family evenings would not have been so warm and peaceful.
body1.focus: Benefit 1: Relieving mothers' stress and strengthening family bonds
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, people should recognize that sharing housework reduces family stress and strengthens bonds | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, relieving stress and strengthening family bonds brings undeniable value in modern life.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that sharing daily housework prevents mothers from carrying the entire family burden alone. This means that parents can relieve stress, reduce fatigue, and reach a healthy balance between work and family time. Another point I would like to make is that doing chores together strengthens family relationships. This is because of the fact that cooking or cleaning side by side builds a strong sense of belonging and helps everyone understand each other through face-to-face interaction.

body2.example: For example, I was taught to cook simple meals, wash my clothes, and tidy my room when I was in high school. For this reason, I got to live comfortably on my own when I moved to another city for university. If I had not practiced doing housework at home, I would not have been able to know that daily chores build such useful independence.
body2.focus: Benefit 2: Teaching children practical life skills and independence
body2.frame: Mở: Secondly, there are further arguments in support of the idea that doing housework teaches children practical life skills | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that teaching children independence plays an important role.
body2.point: In fact, sharing household chores teaches children practical life skills from an early age. This happens because when young people learn how to cook, clean, and manage daily tasks at home, it easily leads to better responsibility and the ability to solve daily problems independently later in life. In addition, children who help around the house grow up respecting their parents' hard work and adapting smoothly to new living environments.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, I strongly agree that sharing household chores equally among family members brings clear benefits, mainly because it helps relieve mothers' stress and supports children's practical life skills and independence. Therefore, both individuals and schools should work together to make the most of shared family responsibilities responsibly.
